description: May 27 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 27 birthday falls in Gemini, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: The May 27 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: On the 27th of May, Gemini's appetite for information meets the broad compassion of 9. The Sun is around five degrees into the Twins, in a decan Mercury governs directly, so ideas flow freely. Interpretive traditions describe a teacher's temperament: someone who wants knowledge to circulate, who explains generously, and who often cares about causes larger than any single conversation.

Astronomically, May 27 puts the Sun near 5° Gemini in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Doubled Mercury makes the first ten degrees of Gemini, roughly May 21 to May 31, the most quicksilver part of an already lively sign. Curiosity is the engine here: questions, conversations, books opened at the middle, two projects running at once. Traditional descriptions stress wit, verbal agility and a talent for translating between people who would not otherwise understand each other. The same speed can make boredom arrive early and commitments feel like cages. For anyone born in this decan, depth often comes not from slowing down overall but from choosing one or two threads to follow all the way through.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for May 27
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a May 27 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous May 27 birthdays
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 27 is the 147th day of the year (148th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Cancer, is usually complete within 26 days, by June 22.

By May 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a May 27 birthday are Henry Kissinger (1923), Christopher Lee (1922) and Rachel Carson (1907).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 27?
faq.answer: May 27 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 27 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 27?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 27?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on May 27 include Henry Kissinger (1923), Christopher Lee (1922) and Rachel Carson (1907). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
